usage: The word 坦桑尼亞 (taan2 song1 nei4 aa3) is used as a proper noun to refer to the country Tanzania.
It often appears in sentences as the subject or object when talking about geography or travel.
When using 坦桑尼亞 in a sentence, you treat it like any other place name without plural or tense changes.
You can combine it with verbs like 去 (heoi3, 'go to') or 來 (loi4, 'come from') to talk about traveling.
It is common to use 坦桑尼亞 with descriptors such as 美麗 (mei5 lai6, 'beautiful') or 大 (daai6, 'big') to describe features about the country.
